Title: [LSJ] Fear of the Void below + Combat Ends

Messages.Author: ira...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Hello LSJ,

A vampire plays Fear of the Void below. The opposing vampire plays a
Combat Ends strike. Does the opposing player still discard a card at
random? I think the answer is yes.

I'm guessing this has already been answered before, but I couldn't
find the answer searching for "fear of the void combat ends," or even
simply "fear of the void."

Thanks,
Ira

Fear of the Void Below
Combat
1 blood
A vampire may play only 1 Fear of the Void Below each combat
[obf] Maneuver.
[dai] Only usable before range is determined. Each round of this
combat defaults to long range, and this vamipre gets an optional press
each round, only usable to end combat.
[DAI] As above, and the opposing minion's controller discards one card
at random from his or her hand during the initial strike resolution
phase of each round.
